recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast surrealist scene featuring a man in a white suit leaning against a large, vibrant orange rectangular monolith. The setting is a room with a black-and-white checkered marble floor and a white paneled grid wall. A smaller orange cube sits in the distance, creating a sense of scale and isolation.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant orange monolith acts as the primary vertical anchor against the neutral background.
The checkered floor provides a rhythmic perspective leading the eye toward the subject.
The white suit blends with the wall panels while contrasting sharply with the orange pillar.
coreInvariants: Matte finish on the orange geometric volumes
Square grid paneling on the rear wall
High-key lighting with soft, directional shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned off-center left, leaning against a monolith that occupies the left third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large orange monolith is the dominant visual anchor due to its saturated color.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the orange monolith, follows the subject down to the checkered floor, and moves right toward the smaller cube and typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the white paneled wall on the right side.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and off-white (background and clothing) providing a clean, clinical atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (floor tiles) providing structural weight and depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant International Orange (geometric blocks) serving as the focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation in the orange elements against a desaturated, high-value environment.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes in the serif line
Tight kerning for a compact block appearance
Lowercase parenthetical metadata in a lighter weight
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminal of the 'g' features a distinct circular flourish

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space of the wall panels

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a bold, colorful serif with a heavy black sans-serif for emphasis.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Receding Hairline or similar high-contrast serif
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ball terminals and elegant weight distribution of the top line.
Provides the necessary weight and impact for the second line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a man in a white suit leaning against a large matte orange rectangular pillar. The floor is a black and white checkered marble. The back wall consists of white square panels. A small orange cube sits on the floor to the right. High-key lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the top right quadrant. The first line should be a bold orange serif. The second line should be a heavy black sans-serif. Add a third line in small orange text inside parentheses below.

verificationChecks: Is the orange pillar perfectly matte and saturated?
Does the checkered floor follow correct linear perspective?
Is the typography aligned to the right side of the frame?
Is the lighting consistent across the subject and the geometric blocks?

adjustableVariables: Pattern size of the checkered floor
mustRedesign: Specific facial tattoos of the subject
Exact brand logos on clothing or props
Specific wording of the title text

avoid: Soft lighting that washes out the orange

postGenerationChecks: Check for 90-degree angles on the orange blocks.
Ensure the white suit is distinct from the white wall panels.
Verify the text is legible against the grid background.
Confirm the floor tiles alternate correctly in perspective.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist geometry + high-contrast checkered floor + monochromatic subject + saturated accent volume.
